en: A black-and-white postcard view of a river spanned by a steel bridge with lattice sides, labeled as the Schönau Bridge. On the left riverbank stands a complex of buildings with steep, tiled roofs, likely part of an industrial or utility facility, and behind them are several power pylons and a tall smokestack. The right side shows a riverside path bordered by a wooden fence and dense vegetation, with a few indistinct figures walking. The image is framed by a white border, with printed caption text at the bottom.
